artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: NEW read-only producer, PYTHONPATH-runnable via `python case_evidence.py --out-json <path> [--out-md <path>]`, ASCII/LF, Python 3.9-compatible (no walrus/match, only stdlib + boto3 + openpyxl already installed). Reads ONLY s3://opal-data-harvest region us-east-1 (derived/model_block/** newest-stamp-per-key via list_objects_v2 + get_object; amgt/harvest/bronze/research-report-extract/** get_object filtered to type==xlsx, then its bronze_key opened live via openpyxl(data_only=True, read_only=True)). Writes ONLY the two paths given on argv (json.dump sort_keys=True, no timestamp field; the .md pass runs every workbook string through .encode('ascii','backslashreplace').decode('ascii') so a workbook's own non-ASCII text -- e.g. em/en-dashes measured in 3 sheets -- survives losslessly as literal \uXXXX escapes rather than raw bytes or a dropped character). No S3 write, no vendor/gateway call anywhere in the module (grep of its own body: zero put_object/delete_object/blpapi/requests calls). Computes NOTHING resembling a Base/Upside/Downside pick: `_ratio_for` either uses the guard's own already-published `value`/`ratio_to_px_last` (SERVED) or reapplies the guard's OWN published formula (eps x median PE [x100 on a minor-unit quote] / px_last) over the guard's OWN published `inputs`/`px_last` for a REFUSED case, purely for display; `ratio_basis` names 'quote-unit' (same currency, or a detected minor-unit pair) vs 'unconverted' (a real currency mismatch, no conversion attempted) vs null (not computable from what the block carries).

Producer output over the live corpus at commit time: ratio_census.rows has 97 entries, one per served-Model-block security_key (independently re-counted by the issuer's own h2_check.py --shape at grading time, see AC1). bins: <0.33 1, 0.5-1.0 13, 1.0-1.5 22, 1.5-2.0 13, 2.0-2.5 1, 2.5-3.0 2, 3.0-3.5 1, >=3.5 3, unconverted 14, not-computable 27 (sums to 97; 0.33-0.5 present in the schema, 0 occupancy). near_ceiling (3.0) below-side: SAN_FP_Equity 2.566, ZTS_US_Equity 2.522, UBER_US_Equity 2.004, NU_US_Equity 1.860, ISRG_US_Equity 1.845; above-side: NFLX_US_Equity 3.043 (the one case the task order's own section 1 names), NOW_US_Equity 4.453, GPN_US_Equity 5.170, CELH_US_Equity 23.021 (only 4 comparable refusals sit above 3.0, so 'above' carries 4 not 5). near_floor (0.33) below-side: BA_US_Equity -0.092 (forward_eps_not_positive, the ONLY comparable ratio under 0.33); above-side: RWE_GR_Equity 0.537, CAT_US_Equity 0.597, NOKIA_FH_Equity 0.635, 2317_TT_Equity 0.788, PWR_US_Equity 0.791. workbook.rows has 669 entries over 53 distinct security_key (of 55 xlsx-bearing keys; 2 keys' workbooks carried no matching Base/Bull/Bear/Upside/Downside/target-price label cell), 0 rows missing a sheet/cell coordinate.
